summary: Student-facing generative AI use in education needs age-appropriate boundaries and educator oversight.
Systems used in teaching and learning should remain inspectable, explainable, and overridable by people.
AI integration planning should cover accessibility, civil rights, digital equity, and human remedy paths.
Schools using online educational services need clear privacy and security protections for student information.
Vendor terms should address data collection, transmission, retention, and reuse explicitly.
Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage activities should be visible in the launch decision.
Generative-AI deployments should account for confabulation, privacy, harmful bias, and information integrity risks.
Public schools need accessible digital services and mobile experiences.
